structure: Nevada Academic Content Standards for Social Studies (rev. Sept 2018). Front matter (cover, credits, contents, C3 introduction, 'Reading the Standards', color coding, disciplinary skills list, content themes table) then grade/course sections. K-5 are one section per grade; 6-8 and 9-12 are banded and organized by content area (course). Each section opens with a title + overview paragraph, then a 'Disciplinary Skills' table (rows: Constructing compelling questions, Creating supporting questions, Gathering and evaluating sources, Developing claims and using evidence, Communicating and critiquing conclusions, Taking informed action; C1 skill name, C4 standards) followed by one or more 'Content Themes' tables (C1/C2 theme name with discipline code H/MC/C/G/E/FL, C4 standards). Standard codes: SS.<grade>.<n> for K-5 (SS.K.1), SS.6-8.<course>.<n> (EWC, WGGS, EUSH, FL) and SS.9-12.<course>.<n> (WH, US, CE, FL); numbering continues from skills into content themes. Theme names are split across many one-line rows in C2 (extraction artifact); the standard text is in C4 of the first row of the group. Overview narratives and suggested topics are labeled examples; no separate examples sections otherwise. References at the end.

issues: Grade/course overview paragraphs (u114,u169,u229,u292,u374,u457,u548,u628-u630,u713-u716,u798,u820-u822,u906-u908,u991-u993,u1084) combine the title with an overview narrative and (for courses) suggested topics; labeled examples per guide (course focus narrative) even though the title is embedded; the title also repeats in each Content Themes table header (standards).
u547 and u819 are band introductions (districts decide course length/order); labeled backup for grades 6-8 / 9-12.
Theme names in C1/C2 are fragmented across many rows (e.g. u68-u112 overview table, u132-u164 etc.); kept with the standards of the same table and never separated from them.
u62-u112: Content themes overview table is badly garbled by columns (C1-C15); labeled backup as an overview, not standards.
u554: code typed 'SS.6.8.EWC.3' and u1096 'SS.912.FL.7' in source (typos); u620 'SS.6-8.EWC.30' lacks a period.

Grades 6-8 courses (EWC, WGGS, EUSH, FL) are taught across 6-8 in any order; no grade-by-grade assignment, so grades '6-8' with course names. 9-12 likewise; Financial Literacy appears as a course in both bands with the same course string but different grades.
Disciplinary Skills rows are repeated for each grade/course with grade-specific codes; labeled with that grade or course only, not as K-12 shared skills.
Missing unit numbers (e.g. u3, u11, u44, u113, u129) are furniture.
